newsitem.title: UK: Destocking hurts Filofax H1 turnover.
newsitem.headline: Destocking hurts Filofax H1 turnover.

text.p: British consumer products supplier Filofax Group said its sales rose six percent while its pre-tax profit plunged 29 percent in the first half of 1996 as changes at a key client negatively influenced its domestic business.

"Trading in the UK, which accounted for over 50 percent of Group sales in the first half, was adversely affected by reorganisation and policy changes by a major customer," Filofax said in a statement on Monday.
Filofax said its six-month sales advanced to 21.0 million stg from 19.9 million in the same six months of 1995 while its pre-tax profit slithered to 2.1 million stg from 2.9 million.
